issue_request: FHIR-19309 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core narrative clarification for STU3. It requested replacing the vague statement that almost all resources may have narrative with wording clarifying the DomainResource boundary: all resources except Bundle, Parameters, and Binary.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GH#8a0d724595. Commit 8a0d724595353fdeb5ad40b672ca092529c9f612 changed source/narrative.html from the vague 'almost all types of resource' phrase to the current explicit exception list. The implementation did not copy the proposed word 'descendant', but it applied the material clarification requested by the issue.
additional_context: source/narrative.html is linked from source/documentation.html and is active documentation source. The DomainResource StructureDefinition is an abstract resource derived from Resource and defines DomainResource.text, while Bundle, Parameters, and Binary derive directly from Resource, matching the three exceptions listed in the narrative page. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-19309 found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already conveys the implementer-visible rule requested by the Jira issue; changing 'is a DomainResource' to 'is a descendant of a DomainResource' would be editorial and not necessary for correctness because the exception list removes the ambiguity.
